adoptions.reason: TASK-368.05: command-routing is drawn as a container bound to its directory; the catalogue's two calls land on its entry points runCliWith and registryOf
Every relationship carries an anchor; the interruptible run binds its own function; the catalogue's help and route-building calls are drawn
Built command dispatch exposes registryOf and childOf after deleting unused surface wrappers
An invocation finds its vault from -C, the environment or the working directory, registers it on first use and names it on every request
semantic move finds its --to vault through Addressed vault, as -C finds the command's own
TASK-472.14: first-use registration says when an untracked vault is renamed, the registry keeps every name unique, and every server watches its file

A set ARCHBOARD_VAULT is refused and no environment variable names a vault, so the finder's origin is -C or the working directory; it refuses a vault whose link leads out of the .archboard/vault layout
A checkout with no vault is told which known vaults hold boards of its code
